title: Knesset Passes Karhi's Media Overhaul Law 53-48 in Pre-Dissolution Blitz
detail: The Knesset voted 53-48 to pass Communications Minister Shlomo Karhi's sweeping media overhaul, part of a coalition legislative blitz before the Knesset dissolves ahead of the October 27, 2026 election. The law expands government control over broadcast media, removing longstanding oversight mechanisms, minimum journalistic standards, obligations to invest in original Israeli productions, and cross-ownership restrictions, while giving government greater influence over ratings and state advertising. Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara and opposition lawmakers warned it threatens press freedom and enables political interference in media.

title: IDF Central Command Chief: Israel Controls 60% of Gaza Strip Territory
detail: IDF Central Command Chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth said Israeli forces control 60% of the Gaza Strip's territory, beyond the roughly 53% allotted to Israel under the October 2025 ceasefire's initial withdrawal line. Bluth said 'the threat of an invasion, as occurred nearly three years ago, is no longer possible.' Netanyahu had previously ordered the military to expand control further, to 70% of the enclave. The same day, Israeli airstrikes hit the Bureij and al-Maghazi refugee camps in central Gaza.

title: PA Releases Alvarez & Marsal Audit of Martyrs' Welfare Payment System
detail: The Palestinian Authority released a summary of an Alvarez & Marsal audit of its welfare payment system for families of prisoners and those killed in the conflict. The audit found no evidence that eligibility or payment amounts are based on a relative's status as an attacker, concluding payments are determined by financial need. The audit identified one round of illicit payments dating to November 2025. The findings respond to long-standing Israeli and US criticism that the PA's 'martyrs' fund' incentivizes violence.

title: Israeli Settlers Attack Ramin Village West of Nablus
detail: Israeli settlers attacked the Palestinian village of Ramin, west of Nablus, causing property damage that was documented by Palestinian inspection teams. The attack is part of a broader surge in West Bank settler violence in 2026 — OCHA has recorded at least 120 illegal farming outposts established since the current Israeli government took power, which Peace Now says have become organizing centers for settler attacks on Palestinians.
